newsitem.title: USA: PIONEER NATURAL CREATED BY MERGER.
newsitem.headline: PIONEER NATURAL CREATED BY MERGER.

text.p: Pioneer Natural Resources Co, the third largest independent oil and gas exploration and production company in the United States, has been created through a merger of Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co and MESA Inc, the company said.
It said shareholders of both companies, at separate meetings Thursday in Dallas, voted in favor of the merger.
Pioneer's common began trading on the New York Stock Exchange at the opening of business Friday. The company said it has about 73 million outstanding common shares.

As a result of the combination, Pioneer will have total proved oil and gas reserves over 3.7 trillion cubic feet of natural gas equivalent with an oil and gas mix of 52 percent natural gas and 48 percent crude oil and liquids.
The company said it has an aggregate reserve life index in excess of 12 years.
As a result of votes in favor of the merger by holders of Mesa Series A and Series B preferred, all Mesa preferred holders will receive Pioneer common stock in the merger.

As a result of the merger, each seven outstanding Mesa common shares were converted into the right to receive one Pioneer common share and each seven outstanding shares of Mesa Series A eight percent cumulative convertible preferred stock and Series B eight percent cumulative convertible preferred stock were converted into the right to receive 1.25 Pioneer common shares.
Each outstanding Parker & Parsley common share was converted into the right to receive one Pioneer common share.
